mapper.select: select id, member_id, capability, status, granted_at, granted_by, create_time, update_time from member_capability where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 1
select id, member_id, capability, status, granted_at, granted_by, create_time, update_time from member_capability where member_id = #{memberId} and capability = #{capability} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into member_capability (member_id, capability, status, granted_at, granted_by, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{capability}, #{status}, #{grantedAt}, #{grantedBy}, now())
